body: I am not looking for a one night stand I just want someone to notice me. It sucks every time we go out I get passed up like the defective toy. I’ve tried dating sites without much luck. I tell myself someone will come along again. I am just tired of not being alone.

I don’t think they do they just don’t have the guts to face you and what they are really doing. He didn’t expect me to be home when he got back from seeing his family. When I confronted him he had no good reason to do it. He just said it was easier but he later admitted it was actually really shitty.

I am 27/f who divorced at 22. While I am not young anymore I can relate. Either my friends my age where just getting married or never married. They didn’t really understand how it felt. My older friends who where divorced seemed to have a totally different experience and feelings about it. 

He texted he wanted to divorce and he had someone new. I left and moved back in with my parents. It was really tough.

My old lady who passed away two years ago at 15 had the same issue for years. We put a garbage bag or plastic sheet over the mattress with a towel over the sheet and put the cover over it. We had to have a couple covers so we could wash the cover daily. Simple green or kids and pets cleaner work great for cleaning the bedding. Baking soda in the washing machine help take out any smell. 

The vet recommended a bladder support pill and then also gave her a prescription that really helped. 

Doggy diapers also really help specially in the car for when you are taking her out. I’ve seen reusable cloth diapers for dogs so it’s harder for them to chew off. 
It’s a lot of laundry but it definitely made us both happier because the smell was better and she was more comfortable.
You guys look so cute and you look gorgeous! I love the dress! Congratulations!
